content: Co-amilozide is the non-proprietary name for a pharmaceutical combination of two active ingredients: amiloride and hydrochlorothiazide. The inclusion of amiloride, a potassium-sparing diuretic, helps counteract the risk of hypokalaemia (low potassium levels) that is commonly associated with the use of hydrochlorothiazide, a thiazide diuretic. In the United Kingdom, co-amilozide is available in two different formulations: 1. A combination containing 2.5 mg of amiloride and 25 mg of hydrochlorothiazide, which is referred to as Co-amilozide 2.5/25 under the British Approved Name (BAN) and marketed under the brand name Moduretic 25. 2. A combination containing 5 mg of amiloride and 50 mg of hydrochlorothiazide, which is referred to as Co-amilozide 5/50 under the British Approved Name (BAN) and marketed under the brand name Moduretic.
